check_constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'upheld_blocked'::text, 'resolved'::text])) AND ((status = 'open'::text) OR ((resolution = ANY (ARRAY['reinstated'::text, 'upheld'::text, 'no_action'::text])) AND (resolution_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(resolution_reason)) >= 3))) AND ((status <> 'upheld_blocked'::text) OR (resolution = 'upheld'::text)) AND ((resolution <> 'upheld'::text) OR (status = 'upheld_blocked'::text))))
CHECK (((actor_role <> 'admin'::text) OR ((admin_notes IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(admin_notes)) >= 3)) OR ((reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(reason)) >= 3))))

CHECK (((to_status = ANY (ARRAY['eligible'::text, 'under_review'::text, 'disqualified'::text])) AND ((from_status IS NULL) OR (from_status = ANY (ARRAY['eligible'::text, 'under_review'::text, 'disqualified'::text])))))

CHECK (((status <> 'cancelled'::text) OR ((cancelled_at IS NOT NULL) AND (cancelled_by IS NOT NULL) AND (cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(cancellation_reason)) >= 10) AND (cancellation_public_explanation IS NOT NULL) AND (cancellation_ground = ANY (ARRAY['fulfilment_impossible'::text, 'unlawful'::text, 'fraudulent'::text, 'unsafe'::text, 'prohibited_by_authority'::text])))))
CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_approval'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'active'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) OR ((entries_closed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (entries_closed_reason IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK ((((status <> 'drawn'::text) OR ((winner_entry_id IS NOT NULL) AND (drawn_at IS NOT NULL))) AND ((status <> 'closed_no_winner'::text) OR ((winner_entry_id IS NULL) AND (no_winner_reason IS NOT NULL)))))

CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_approval'::text, 'rejected'::text])) OR (prize_governance_version = 0) OR ((prize_category = ANY (ARRAY['premium_electronics'::text, 'luxury_stay_or_holiday'::text, 'designer_fashion_or_accessories'::text, 'fine_dining_experience'::text, 'beauty_and_wellness'::text, 'events_and_experiences'::text, 'home_technology_and_appliances'::text, 'vehicle_or_major_prize'::text, 'brand_voucher'::text, 'other_approved_premium'::text])) AND (sponsor_name IS NOT NULL) AND (prize_supplied_by IS NOT NULL) AND (prize_retail_value_aed IS NOT NULL) AND (prize_retail_value_aed > (0)::numeric) AND (prize_evidence_verified = true) AND (naseeb_custody = ANY (ARRAY['naseeb_holds'::text, 'sponsor_holds_committed'::text, 'provider_fulfils'::text])) AND (fulfilment_method IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_approval'::text, 'rejected'::text])) OR (prize_governance_version = 0) OR ((approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_approval'::text, 'rejected'::text])) OR ((published_at IS NOT NULL) AND (closes_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((status <> 'rejected'::text) OR ((rejected_at IS NOT NULL) AND (rejected_by IS NOT NULL) AND (rejection_ground IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((executed_by IS NOT NULL) <> (executed_by_job IS NOT NULL)))

CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'declined'::text, 'unable_to_complete'::text, 'awaiting_policy'::text])) OR ((outcome_code IS NOT NULL) AND (admin_notes IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(admin_notes)) >= 3))))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION integrity_audit_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
    BEGIN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '% is append-only; % is not permitted', TG_TABLE_NAME, TG_OP;
    END;
    $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION privacy_requests_no_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
    BEGIN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'privacy_requests rows cannot be deleted; a request may change state but is never erased'
        USING ERRCODE = 'raise_exception';
    END;
    $function$
